content.title:
The 2026 St. Charles St. Patrick's Parade is almost here, and we welcomed some great guests to help celebrate the occasion. 🍀

In our first segment, we spoke with Brian McNally, owner of McNally's Heating and Cooling and presenting sponsor of the parade, about his business and his commitment to the community.
 
Then in our second segment, we chatted with Jeanne Jardien and her dog, Traveler, about the Western Irish Setter Club and their involvement in this year’s parade.

Tune in to the full episode to learn more: stcalliance.org/podcast 🔗

🗓️: St. Charles St. Patrick's Parade: March 14th, 2026 | St. Charles Business Alliance | Facebook
